listing.name: Unbalance Patch 2
listing.summary: Drastically rebalances combat and economy to create a harsher, survival-focused experience.
listing.aiSummary: Drastically rebalances combat and economy to create a harsher, survival-focused experience.

description:
Rewritten as of 25.05.2026

Unbalance Patch 2 is a terrifying reinterpretation of Starsector, where the player is broke. Pirates and Pathers are threatening. And the Core Worlds are oppressive. The economy has been severely nerfed. There are no longer easy pathways to success. Instead the player has to constantly struggle against being able to pay their crew wages, and being able to rebuild. Their constantly mowed down fleet

The Starsector balance has been drastically tweaked. Energy weapons are weaker. Ammo mechanics are back for ballistics. Cruisers and capitals feel slow, but more importantly, too expensive to be affordable to anyone. Game focuses a lot on fights between little and poor idiots. Throwing garbage cans and sinks at each other. Get yourself invested within the gameplay of having two Apogees and a Fury. Along a bunch of frigates and destroyers. Delivering packages to be able to pay the debt you have put yourself in, from trying to set up a colony.

The Core Worlds' massive fleets are at constant odds with the swarms of pirates that lurk beyond the horizon. Make yourself comfortable by playing towards both sides. Or slaughter in the name of one. Trade. Smuggle. Sneak. And die alone and miserable. With no one to help you. In the Persean Sector. A world within which many have seemingly lost hope. Instead pledging themselves to the ideals of strength and greed.

Gameplay Footage (note these videos may not fully represent the current state of the mod):

Spoiler- Download zip file

- Unpack zip file

- Go into Unbalance Patch file

- Unpack the 5 submods into your mods directory[close]

It is recommended that you play this mod with Procgen Overhaul

Most Recent Patch Notes:

1.4.2.2.4.3.3.7

Spoiler- Hyperion has Starfarer durability, ordnance points and speed

- Has phase teleporter that has a 0 second cooldown

- Phase ship durability set to vanilla

- Missile speed adjusted to be much slower across the board

- Mirroring fighter balance changes

- This also applies to Threat, Shrouded Dweller and Omega weapons

- This also applies to Canister Flak system

- You now always receive a reputation penalty when trading on the black market, regardless of transponder being on or off, as well as penalties related to selling military equipment and goods to the market you sell to adversary

- Anywhere

- Additionally the market's vulnerability to trade is increased by a factor of 10. Meaning you need to sell or buy only 100k worth of goods to incur the maximum available penalty

- Gave Path Paladin PD as they didn't have it

- Fulgent once again has High Energy Focus, as it is no longer considered slow for a destroyer, kinda

- Increased the amount of bombs for Piranha from 5 to 7 (note they do 600 damage each, instead of vanilla's 400)

-

Doubled the speed at which everything travels in the campaign

(reverted)

- Reduced the amount of patrols to vanilla level

- Removed the Ancyra's military base as it was causing a bug where a person with no title would be generated

- Paladin PD quasi reworked to its Starfarer version

- Gave Broadsword and Lux Swarmer missiles again

- Gave Spark a phase skimmer ability

- Tempest drones can now roam

- Adjusted drones with light MGs to be slower like in Starfarer

Major shift back (redownload to acquire)

- Restored previous missile and fighter balancing

- Phase cloak now has a 2 second cooldown and uses 0-flux boost

- Removed Transparency and Hyperarmor

- Restored Delicate and Rugged

- Note phase  cloak no longer accelerates time

- Frigates still somewhat slow

- Hyperion now has a 10 second cooldown on the ship system

- Derelict costs increased from 3 and 6 to 4 and 8

- Remnant frigates DP cost increased by 1

- Vanguard, Tempest, Scarab now 8 DP

- Brawler uses mav jets again

- Both flare systems now gain back charges to an extent

- Have a 5 second cooldown

-

Reduced Heatseeker's fuel quantity from 15 to 7.5 seconds (by 50%, might have gotten the number wrong here)

(reverted)

- All versions of the displacer now have 3 charges again instead of 2

- Doom mines have twice as much health to compensate for the fact that phase cloak's time acceleration no longer boosts its system

Revert minor (redownload to acquire)

- Phase cloak again has 0 second cooldown

- Has 0-flux boost when travelling to compensate for some AI errors

- Restored Transparency and Hyperarmour

Reverting (redownload to acquire)

- Reverted frigate mobility nerfs

- Rebalanced DP costs of premium frigates back to somewhat sensible levels

- Nerfed stations by halving their hull and armour durability stats, including drones which go back to vanilla stats instead

- This was done to make orbital stations less overpowered and easier to kill with smaller ships

Mioidawndioaw (redownload to acquire)

- Increased Thumper damage from 90 to 150

- Increased Heavy Mortar's range to 700

- Increased base armour to 15%

- Reverted Hyperarmour and Transparency

- Delicate increases PPT decay by 25% not 50%

- Sunder mobility nerfed

Doot (redownload to acquire)

- Reverted Thumper to 90 damage

- Reverted 15% minimal residual armour

Wat (redownload to acquire)

-

Brought back 15% minimal residual armour

(nvm)

- Reverted range nerfs for Thumper, Heavy Mortar, Light Mortar

Eh (redownload to acquire)

- Paladin PD rebalanced to be sort of vanilla strength before it was changed to have 0.3 flux efficiency

Emidawmiodaw (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed mainline EMP weapons again

Hdhuidnawd (redownload to acquire)

- Gave indies a much greater choice of capital ships (steal away)

- Fixed a bug that caused the Automated Legion XIV variant to appear in as random wrecks

Uyghurlivesmatter (redownload to acquire)

- Scarab DP changed from 8 to 6

- Omen DP changed from 6 to 5

- Changed Fury and Venture DP costs to 15 and reduced cost

- Increased base flux of small Derelicts by 1k, from 750 to 1.75k

- Increased minimal residual armour to 15% again

Krkirtjhrtoir (redownload to acquire)

- Added 1k flux to each Low Tech non-civilian ship representative pool

- Devastator nerfed again, increased the range at which the Devastator shots begin to randomly explode from basically melee to at half

- Nerfed Impact Mitigation+, now gives Auxiliary Thrusters s-mod effect

- Nerfed Auxiliary Thrusters s-mod effect, no longer exists

Wagnifoawda (redownload to acquire)

- Impact Mitigation added -10% armor damage taken by kinetic weapons

KHEKHEKHE (redownload to acquire)

- Unnerfed Sunder

- Rebalanced Aurora flux stats

- Unnerfed third tier industry skills

- Fixed some fighters' poor armour stats

Goo goo ga ga (redownload to acquire)

- Readjusted Gladius to have semi-vanilla loadout

- Readjusted Warthog's flux stats to be able to sustain fire

- Nerfed Flash (back to having 4 bombs)

- Nerfed Cyclone (no longer shoots fully accelerated projectiles)

- Cobra once again shoots fully-accelerated projectiles[close]

1.4.2.2.4.3.3.7.1

- Increased annihilator's projectiles for the Khopesh bomber from 5x2 to 7x2

- Reworked some star systems

- Reworked Samarra and a few other ones

Weagagawdawd (redownload to acquire)

- Added a dozen or two small colonies around the Persean Sector to serve as targets for radiant quests and add a bit more immersion with there being more satellites to main worlds

Most recent fix (redownload to acquire)

- Solar Shielding no longer affects shields

- Fixed some typos
